description: Shared Renovate config for DiverOfDark image repos. Repos opt in with extends: ["github>DiverOfDark/renovate-config"].

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the release-age wait and the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly cargo update / npm lockfile refresh: pulls in patch fixes of transitive deps.

packageRules.description: Patch updates merge themselves once CI is green. A merge to the default branch deploys through GitImage.

Breaking updates (majors, and 0.x minors which are breaking under semver) usually need code changes. They wait for a tick on the Dependency Dashboard instead of taking PR slots from patches, lockfile maintenance and security fixes.
0.x minor bumps are breaking under Cargo/npm semver.

customManagers.description: cargo-auditable pinned in Dockerfiles (RUN cargo install cargo-auditable@X.Y.Z --locked).
